messages:
elaine (sales): Hey team — ACME wants a 2-week BYO-KMS POC. They require HSM-backed CMKs, attestation proof, and a rotation plan. Also have pricing questions for POC vs Dedicated. Can we sync on blockers?

mateo (solutions): What HSMs are they using? AWS CloudHSM or on-prem Thales/Entrust? Any specific FIPS level or egress constraints?

sam (acme-cust): We have on-prem Thales Luna V4 and need FIPS 140-2 L3. Keys must never leave our HSM unwrapped. We can proxy signing requests through our appliance.

jordan (crypto-ops): Ok — we support envelope encryption for BYOK + HSM-backed CMKs. For on-prem HSM proxying we need a TLS-mutual auth tunnel + allowlist IPs. Attestation we can provide: code-signing cert + HSM attestation report (if vendor provides).

jordan (crypto-ops): Example of what we need from their side:
```
- client mTLS cert (PEM)
- proxy endpoint (host:port)
- allowed IPs for egress (CIDR list)
- sample signing API (POST /sign) with payload format
```

mateo (solutions): Also flagging latency: proxying each token generation to on-prem HSM will add RTT. Need target TPS / tokens-per-second so we can size a cache+prefetch policy.

matt (eng): @mateo +1. For high QPS we can do short-lived ephemeral encryption keys derived from CMK to avoid roundtrips per token. But that adds a rotation/TTL tradeoff. What's their expected burst?

sam (acme-cust): Peak ~200 rps, average 40 rps. P95 latency target for generation calls is <200ms.

matt (eng): 200 rps to on-prem via internet is risky for 200ms p95. We'll need either a dedicated VPC peering or colocated proxy. Options:
- VPC peering + private interconnect (best latency)
- Software proxy in their cloud (we call private proxy)
- Accept larger p95 and use caching/ephemeral keys

lucy (legal): For attestation & compliance: we can supply a short-form KMS integration appendix, evidence of SOC2, and a rotation policy template. If they need a vendor HSM attestation report, they must provide it — we cannot generate third-party HSM attestation for them.

tyler (billing): Pricing notes: POC — we can offer $5k of credits for 2 weeks for evaluation (covers tokens + infra). HSM proxy egress traffic billed at normal rate + network costs if we create a Dedicated bridge. Dedicated pricing for reserved capacity (monthly) will include an HSM connector surcharge — TBD based on throughput.

elaine (sales): Action items so far: 1) ask ACME for mTLS cert + proxy endpoint + vendor attestation doc; 2) get target TPS (they gave 200/40); 3) engineering to propose latency mitigation options and rough cost delta. Can someone own the engineering scoping?

matt (eng): I can own scoping. I'll spin up a perf-run checklist. Need an env — @deploy-bot can you create a POC env with a private test proxy and throughput metrics enabled?

deploy-bot: POC env created: poc-acme-1742. Metrics endpoint: https://infra.redwood/poc/poc-acme-1742/metrics.

jordan (crypto-ops): Also note rotation: They require a 30-day rotation window with a max 72h blackout during key swaps. We support canary rollouts for CMK rotations but will need a signed acceptance from their ops for any outage window >1h.

sam (acme-cust): 30 days rotation fine. We cannot have >1h blackout. Can we do zero-downtime switchover?

matt (eng): Zero-downtime is possible if ephemeral keys + double-write during transition. That will increase request path complexity. I'll draft a runbook.

mateo (solutions): For the security questionnaire: they asked whether keys can be provably not exported. Answer: if you use their HSM and we only proxy, keys never leave their HSM. If Redwood hosts the CMK we offer HSM-backed options and provide key material lifecycle logs.

lucy (legal): I'll prepare the integration appendix and a suggested NDA addendum for attestation exchange. Expect a draft by EOD tomorrow.

tyler (billing): I'll model cost delta for three options: 1) proxy-only (we call their HSM) 2) proxy + edge caching (ephemeral derivation) 3) Dedicated bridge with private interconnect. Will share numbers by Friday.

elaine (sales): Great. Can we target an internal sync on Thursday 9am PT to finalize POC SOW and checklist? Also I need a one-paragraph summary to share with the customer.

matt (eng): Sync confirmed. I'll also throw together a short curl example they can run against our test proxy to validate requests:
```bash
curl -X POST https://poc-acme-1742.redwood.ai/sign \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --cert client.crt --key client.key \
  -d '{"payload":"hello","alg":"RSASSA-PSS"}'
```

sam (acme-cust): That looks good. We'll get certs and attestation doc to you by Wed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

elaine (sales): Thanks everyone — I'll capture notes and follow up with SOW draft after Thursday sync. :pray:
